title: Individual Data Pre-Processing — IndividualDataPP
text: data data.frame, individual reserving. number development periods can larger number accident periods. id character, data column contains policy identifier. NULL (default), assume row observation. assume observation can one reporting time, null take reporting time first row id. continuous_features character, continuous features columns scaled. categorical_features character, categorical features columns one-hot encoded. accident_period character, contains name column data corresponding accident period. calendar_period character, contains name column data corresponding calendar period. input_time_granularity character, time unit input data. Granularity supported: "days": input data daily. "months": input data monthly. "quarters": input data quarterly "semesters": six-month periods. "years": input data yearly. Default months. output_time_granularity character, time unit output data. granularity supported input data: "days": output data daily scale. "months": output data monthly scale. "quarters": output data quarterly scale. "semesters": six-month periods. "years": output data yearly scale. output granularity must equal coarser input granularity. Also, output granularity must consistent input granularity, meaning time conversion must possible. E.g., possible group quarters years. Quarters can also grouped semesters. Default quarters. years numeric, number development years study. calendar_period_extrapolation logical, whether spline calendar extrapolation considered cox model fit. Default `FALSE`. continuous_features_spline character, names continuous features model splines; NULL uses linear terms. Use "AP_i" remapped accident-period feature. degrees_cf numeric, degrees spline smoothing continuous features. degrees_of_freedom_cf numeric, degrees freedom splines smoothing continuous features. degrees_cp numeric, degrees spline smoothing calendar period effect. degrees_of_freedom_cp numeric, degrees freedom splines smoothing calendar period effect.

title: Individual Data Pre-Processing — IndividualDataPP
text: IndividualDataPP list containing training.data   (observed rows), full.data (encoded rows),   data_information (conversion factor, input/output formulas,   feature names, time units, horizon, original column names). pre-processing, provide standard encoding time components. regards output training.data. ReSurv notation: AP_i: Input granularity accident period. AP_o: Output granularity accident period. DP_i: Input granularity development period forward time. DP_rev_i: Input granularity development period reverse time. DP_rev_o: Output granularity development period reverse time. TR_i: Input granularity truncation time. TR_o: Output granularity truncation time. : event indicator, framework equal one entry.

title: Individual Data Pre-Processing — IndividualDataPP
text: Accident reporting periods indexed one. Development time DP_i = RP_i - AP_i + 1; reverse development time DP_rev_i = DP_max - DP_i + 1, truncation time TR_i = AP_i - 1. Training retains observed rows DP_rev_i > TR_i. conversion factor input time unit divided output time unit (example, 1/3 months quarters). Accident calendar periods grouped using ceiling; development periods also account position accident period within output period. Days use 360-day year development horizon.
